segments.speaker: YOU

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: def two_sum(nums, target):

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: for i in range(len(nums)):

segments.speaker: YOU

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: if nums[i] + nums[j] == target: return [i, j]

segments.text: That's correct — it checks every pair exactly once and returns the indices. Let me trace it on [2,7,11,15] with target 9: i=0, j=1, 2+7=9, returns [0,1]. Correct.
